to ensure data is accurate and can reliably inform internal decisions Develop and maintain data quality protocols covering sample validation and field monitoring Conduct desk reviews and literature reviews to ensure data collection approaches, survey design, and analytical frameworks are grounded in current evidence and best practice Feed data quality findings and flags to the Senior Manager for review and sign-off Research Analysis and Outputs Generate sampling protocols and support the design of sampling strategies for studies and surveys Analyse key data streams to surface high-level findings that inform internal decision-making, working with the Senior Manager to refine outputs before broader sharing Prepare first-round drafts of research reports, presentations, and summary decks for Senior Manager review Support synthesis of findings from pulse surveys, M&E, and qualitative studies into clear internal and donor-facing communications Support the Senior Manager in preparing research findings for donor presentations and partner updates Project Operations Liaise with internal admin functions - including finance and compliance - to ensure smooth operations Coordinate with the programs team to align operational and research plans, surfacing conflicts or misalignments early Manage budgets, tracking expenditure and flagging risks to the Senior Manager Develop and maintain project timelines, coordinating across teams to resolve delays External Coordination Participate in external meetings with academic research teams and other partners to ensure all activities are aligned with internal GD plans and timelines Serve as an operational point of contact for external partners, escalating strategic decisions to the Senior Manager Team Management & Recruitment Directly manage the Field Manager, providing regular supervision and support Support the Field Manager in coordinating field staff performance and scheduling Lead recruitment efforts to build a strong internal research team, ensuring capacity meets all data collection and research needs Support onboarding and development of new team members to maintain high standards across the team Desired Qualifications 5–7 years of progressive experience in research program management, ideally within an international development, NGO, academic, or high-growth organisation context. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex research findings for a range of audiences including field teams, policymakers, donors, and external research partners. Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where success requires adaptability, intellectual curiosity, and a significant degree of learning by doing. Working at GiveDirectly GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
